title: Composer: layout, auto height, live paragraphs

message.text: Taken: one Sonnet minion is doing the repeated-text bug first, then moving the mic beside the text area and making the area grow as you talk. The live paragraphs with headings (3) come after that, because they use the same composer code. I'll report when it lands.

Landed, live and uncommitted, except the live paragraphs with headings (3), which I have not started. The repeated-text bug is fixed: the composer guessed which part of the box was yours and wrote the transcript on top again. Now it records your own text explicitly, and a test of 30 growing updates then Send posted exactly one copy. Send clears everything, and after a send in mid-stream only the new words show. The mic is now beside the text area with no radius between them, and the box grows as you talk. The 20,000-character cap is in but wasn't exercised in the test.
